· Position relative to SMA100/200 (36,885 KRW/36,416 KRW): confirming strong mid-to-long-term downtrend.
· 52-week position (34.2%) + approaching historical low price range.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (47.2→32.7): confirming entry into oversold territory, downward momentum continues.
· MACD histogram trajectory (211.9761→-392.1988): bearish crossover and worsening momentum persist.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Lower Band 25,073 KRW): approaching lower band, 30.02% band width indicating expanded volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support (23,100 KRW): key support zone near weekly SMA100 (23,163 KRW).
· Swing Resistance (30,570 KRW): initial resistance zone for short-term bounces.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern: 5-day low 23,720 KRW, 20-day low 23,720 KRW, confirming sideways consolidation.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (1.02x vs 5-day average): weak volume accompanying current price action.
· Current phase diagnosis: downtrend continues, potential for further decline due to RSI oversold entry and MACD worsening, maintaining a wait-and-see approach.
